description: Let \(T\supseteq Q\) and let the fixed unary arithmetic formula satisfy D1–D3. For every arithmetic sentence \(A\), if \(T\vdash\Box A\to A\), then \(T\vdash A\). No consistency or soundness hypothesis is required.
